title: Is scl rational for chains in the torus with one cone point of order 2?
body:
## The question

Let O be the two-dimensional orbifold obtained from a torus by introducing a single cone
point of order 2, and let C be a chain in the orbifold fundamental group of O: a formal
sum of cyclically reduced conjugacy classes whose total homology class is trivial.

Is scl(C) always rational?

The orbifold is hyperbolic: its orbifold Euler characteristic is 0 - (1 - 1/2) = -1/2,
which is negative.

An important test case rather than a subgoal, on the same footing as the closed genus 2
surface: no theorem is known that would make a solution here imply the general statement.

Note that this is a variant of the corresponding question for closed hyperbolic surfaces
rather than a special case of it. The underlying object is an orbifold and not a closed
surface, and neither question implies the other.
author: danny
